content.text:
**What I'd tell my son:**

"Look, I didn't decide anything. I'll ask you, or the bank. The page says the best pair is the account at 'פסגות' with the fund 'ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500'. It says that if I put in 10,000 ₪ and then 500 ₪ a month, after ten years I'd have about 86,492 ₪. That's the number that stuck with me. Next to that pair it says 'דמי ניהול: 0%' and 'הבחירה'. But I'm not really sure. I've heard the name Psagot, but it isn't my bank. What I don't understand at all is 'קרן מחקה' and what S&P is. The page also says the account matters more than the fund: the worst account comes out 22,985 ₪ lower. That one worried me."

**What I looked at, in order:**
- **Top box.** 'הפקדתם 70,000 ₪', and next to it 'הכי הרבה נשאר בזוג הזה 86,492 ₪'. Under that, 'פסגות · ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)'.
- **The line charts.** I didn't try to read them, with all those little marks. Under them I read the sentence: 'בחשבון היקר ביותר נשארים 22,985 ₪ פחות'. That sentence I understood.
- **Right box.** 'פסגות ניירות ערך בע"מ', and below it a list of accounts: פסגות first, then אלטשולר, then a third one. In the פסגות row it says 'דמי משמרת 699 ₪'. I don't know that word.
- **Left box.** The same fund, with 'דמי ניהול 0%… 0.02% נאמן'. Under it the other funds have a minus in red (‎−43 ₪, ‎−213 ₪), so I stayed away from those.

**What I skipped:**
- All the coloured buttons: 'צוברת', 'חשיפה לדולר', 'מנוטרל מט"ח' and the rest.
- The fund with the long English name (iShares…).
- The long paragraph of small text in the right box.

**What I didn't understand:** קרן מחקה, S&P 500, (4D), דמי משמרת, נאמן, צוברת, מנוטרל מט"ח, מחלקת דיבידנד, תעודת סל / ETF, 'עוד לא נאסדק', and the 'לא בחשבון' tag.

**What bothered me:**
- The whole screen is black, with lots of small grey text and lots of numbers. That made me nervous.
- There's nothing on this page about a deposit or about whether it's safe.
- Small grey text I couldn't read: the row under 'פסגות' and the paragraph under 'כל החשבונות'.

I'd stop after this one screen.
